# Review — kebra-nagast-ch101

Dillmann unavailable; lexical calls hedged (?). No modern translation opened. Units numbered 0-10 (0 = heading). After the edits the units' `t` still join to the packet exactly, gloss keys = novel forms exactly, and every `__broaden__` entry starts with the whole known entry.

## Pass 1 — units.json

Changes (unit · field · severity · wrong · done)
1. about · moderate · "first, clean outer court": "clean" and "outer" are not in the Geʿez. Now "a first court to be made for her (the Ark, it seems), closed to the unclean".
2. 1 · l, i, n (ዴዴ) · moderate · ዴዴ was given an invented sense "round-about / all around". It is the same unidentified word as in ch. 98a ("አነ ዴዴ", left unplaced). Now left as printed, ዴዴ(?) in l and ዴዴ (?) in i; note says no lexical support and that the sense may be adverbial.
3. 1 · n (ባሕቲታ) · major · "-ታ" called a possessive. It is ባሕቲት + -ኣ 'her' (as the known gloss says). Fixed.
4. 1 · l, i (ባሕቲታ) · moderate · "alone-of-her" and "not only there" dropped 'her alone'. Now "her-alone" and "not there with her alone".
5. 1 · l, i, n (አምሳሊሃ) · moderate · rendered plural "likenesses". አምሳል is singular (published ch. 55 reads 'her likeness'). Now "all her-likeness" and "wherever any likeness of her is". "Copies of the Ark" hedged (?).
6. 1 · n (ዘኢኮነ) · minor · ኮነ is a perfect and ንጹሐ the accusative predicate; the muddled "'he who is not' ዘ-ኢ-ኮነ" was rewritten.
7. 1 · n (ሥኡብ) · minor · sense unhedged in the note although the gloss hedges it. Hedged (?).
8. 1 · n (ዐጸደ ቀዳሚ) · minor · "(outer)" is unsupported; removed. ዐጸደ is the accusative with an adjective, now said.
9. 2 · l · minor · "and-I-was" in l beside "I-have-been" elsewhere. Now uniform in l; the i keeps "I was" for the past rescues.
10. 2 · n · minor · "different first letter" for ህሎኩ. It is the same consonant, sixth order instead of first. Fixed. Also added that ሀሎ is stative, so the perfect also serves as present, which explains 'I was' against 'I have been'.
11. 3 · l, i, n (ወመትሕቴሃኒ ለጽልመት ወለቀላያት) · moderate · The second ለ- was read as "for the deeps" and made the object of አዐምድ, with the preceding ለ- as "for the darkness". The two ለ- are parallel genitives after the anticipating -ሃ ('beneath it too, of the darkness and of the deeps'). Reworked l, i and n; the object reading is kept as a (?) alternative.
12. 3 · n · minor · "present-habitual" label for the imperfect አዐምድ. Now "imperfect".
13. 3 · n (ይጸወን) · moderate · ኪያየ is accusative, so a plain passive "is borne by me" does not fit the grammar. Note now flags the loose reading and a possible 'rests upon' (?). i left as the sense-level rendering.
14. 3 · n · minor · added the cross-reference to ተይ in ch. 100 part 2 (ወእሳት ወተይ), which that part's note already mirrors.
15. 4 · n (እሰፍን) · minor · alternative ሰፈረ 'measure' (እሰፍር) added as a hedge (?).
16. 5 · n · minor · "chariot of the cherubim" is first of all 1 Chronicles 28:18 (?), not only Ezekiel; added. Added the grammar of እምኵሉ after a passive (agent), with 'more than all' as the alternative (?).
17. 6 · i · minor · አርያም (singular) rendered "the heights". Now "the highest heaven", as in the note and gloss.
18. 8 · l · minor · stray capital "Existing" → "existing".
19. 8 · n · minor · "-ሉ and -ቱ are 'its'" is wrong: the suffix is -ሁ, absorbed into the final consonant. Fixed.
20. 9 · l, i · moderate · house rendering: እግዚኣብሔር is 'God' (published parts), not "the Lord". i also changed "says" to "said" (ይቤ is a perfect).
21. 9 · n · moderate · muddled sentence on ይቤ እግዚኣብሔር ("a reminder of the speaker") and the awkward "(?: the echo is general)". Rewritten: the formula names the speaker for the first time, so the 'he' of ይቤሎ is God. Isaiah 46:9 echo: "Compare Isaiah 46:9 ('there is none like me'); the echo is general (?)."
22. 10 · n (ሣረረታ, አጽንዐታ) · major · parsed as 3ms verb + suffix "-ታ". They are 3fs perfect (-ት, agreeing with feminine እዴየ and የማንየ) + -ኣ 'her' (ምድር, also feminine). Fixed in the note, and in the gloss for አጽንዐታ.
23. 10 · n (Isaiah 48:13) · minor · the quoted English was the remembered Bible wording ("spread out the heavens"). Replaced with a paraphrase of the correspondence, noting the verbs differ.

- 3 · ይሰጠሙ spelling (ጠ for an expected ጥ) · no basis to call it an error without Dillmann or the plate; label "3mp subjunctive" kept.
- 3 · አዐምድ as G vs causative · both readings fit the form; the existing (?) kept and not escalated.
- 5 · ወሰ ፡ ብእ crux · the drafter's reading ('and men') is hedged properly; no better reading found.
- 7 · Psalm 7:9 / Jeremiah 17:10 · correct; kept.
- 8 · Deuteronomy 4:39 / Exodus 20:3 · correct; kept.
- 2 · Daniel 6, Jonah 1:17, Genesis 37, Jeremiah 38:6 · correct (Jeremiah is 45:6 in LXX numbering; not changed).
- 10 · Trinitarian note, 'Son' capitalised · fine.

## Pass 2 — gloss.json

Changes
1. ወዛሕል · minor · the entry said "cf. ወዛሕል in ch. 101", a self-reference. Now compares ወተይ beside እሳት.
2. ለጽልመት · moderate · the main reading "to/for the darkness" was not the use. Now "of the darkness (ለ- as genitive link, after the anticipating suffix of መትሕቴሃ)" first, the old reading second.
3. ወለቀላያት · moderate · "and for/of the deeps" with no stated function. Now "and of the deeps (ለ- genitive link)", with the object reading as (?).
4. ወመትሕቴሃኒ · minor · "construct መትሕቴ" is wrong; መትሕቴ- is the stem before suffixes. Fixed; ጽልመት named as the anticipated owner.
5. ይጸወን · moderate · added the accusative ኪያየ problem and the 'rests upon' possibility.
6. እሰፍን · minor · added the possible ሰፈረ (እሰፍር).
7. አጽንዐታ · major · "3ms perfect + -ታ" corrected to 3fs perfect አጽንዐት + -ኣ, with the feminine subject.
8. __broaden__ ዴዴ (new) · moderate · the known entry says "title of Christ after አነ"; this use is after ዐጸደ ቀዳሚ. Old whole + new.
9. __broaden__ ዐጸደ (new) · minor · known entry covers only 'pen of' and 'vineyard'; added the accusative with adjective.
10. __broaden__ አምሳሊሃ (new) · minor · added 'every likeness of her' with ኵሉ.
11. __broaden__ ፯ · minor · added the spoken form ሰብዐቱ before a noun, hedged (?).
